note: Features nest one level: a parent feature and its sub-features (children). Names are the match key when re-importing.

features.name: Cross-case document registry

features.name: Sources
features.note: First step of the case workflow: get every page in, classified and OCR'd, before the overview.

children.name: File upload with OCR and auto-classification
children.note: Drag and drop or select PDF, TIFF, JPEG, PNG up to 100 MB. ALIE classifies and OCRs each page. Per-file status, type, pages, size, uploader.

children.name: Archive / Binder / Timeline views
children.note: Three views of the case file: the archive table, the binder, and a timeline.

children.name: Scope and report-unit summary
children.note: Total files and pages, report units found and how many need a look, Open report units.

features.name: Overview
features.note: Second step: the case brief and the gate into critical review.

children.name: Brief extraction
children.note: Extract Brief builds the case brief from the processed documents; workspace automation can run it after OCR. Observed on case 514882885: 'Brief extraction failed. Click Extract Brief to retry.'

children.name: Ready for critical review gate
children.note: Confirms all documents are processed and hands off to Begin Critical Review.

children.name: Document search
children.note: Search box over the case documents at the top of every step.

features.name: Review
features.note: Third step: work the queues left to right before drafting. Deleting a report removes its pages from Unreadable and Duplicates.

children.name: Reports queue (report units)
children.note: Auto-split reports with date of the event or visit date, detected type (Décision CNESST, Note d'évolution, Expertise médicale / BEM, Rapport de consultation, Rapport du médecin traitant, Type non classé), page ranges, 'needs a look' flag, sort by date or name, bulk select, Open.

children.name: Unreadable queue
children.note: Pages with handwritten or unreadable content flagged per page with the report they belong to; Review action per page.

children.name: Duplicates finder
children.note: Find duplicates within one document (the same report repeated in one large file) or across documents (pick the original).

features.name: Draft
features.note: Fourth step: the draft journey and the door into the report editor.

children.name: Draft journey tracker
children.note: Progress through Sources, Overview, Review and Draft; items still needing review; sections drafted with a resume link.

children.name: Open the report (204 editor entry)
children.note: Opens the full-screen CNESST 204 report editor at the section to resume.

features.name: Left panel
features.note: Left panel on every case step in Health: Files, Report units, Recycle bin, Collaboration, Dictate.

children.name: Files panel
children.note: The case files with per-file status, VIEW and scope.

children.name: Report units panel
children.note: Every report ALIE found inside the pages (103 on the sample case, 48 needing a look) with kind, date and pages, paginated.

children.name: Recycle bin
children.note: Anything removed from Review lands here and can be restored. The uploaded document is never changed. Legal shows starting vs final materials page counts.

children.name: Collaboration panel
children.note: Case-level collaboration with external parties, opened from the side rail. Being consolidated with Share into the Portal (David). Sub-items: Requests (New Request; active requests list); Document requests with secure link (Generate a secure link to request documents from a third party); Messages / secure exchange (New secure exchange; replies land directly in the case); Annotations (Shared annotations on the case); Opinion requests (New opinion request to another professional).

children.name: Dictate
children.note: Dictation dialog from the side rail and from report sections (Ctrl+J in Ask ALIE too). Sub-items: Recording modes: quick note, long session, paste transcript (Three ways in: a quick note, a long session, or pasting an existing transcript); Dictation mode and language settings (Mode (machine mode…), dictation language and output language selectors); Patient consent confirmation before recording (Consent notice must be confirmed (or remind me later) before Start Recording); Dictation history (History tab of past dictations).

features.name: CNESST 204 report editor
features.note: Full-screen editor with a section rail grouped as Identification, Mandate, Interview, History, Examination, Conclusions and Signature. Each section has Mark complete and Previous / Continue navigation.

children.name: Report overview and export
children.note: Generate full report, document preview (15 pages), readiness check listing mandatory sections not yet reviewed, Save draft, Print, Export PDF, Export Word, Refetch data.

children.name: A · Worker information
children.note: Identity, health insurance number, date of birth, contact, worker file number, event and recurrence dates. Suggest from de-identified documents; never sent to a language model. Re-sync Section A.

children.name: B · Physician information
children.note: Pulled from the physician profile (name, credentials, licence, clinic, address, phone, email) with a profile-incomplete warning.

children.name: 1 · Evaluation mandate
children.note: Extract from documents to prefill the mandate.

children.name: 2 · CNESST-accepted diagnoses
children.note: Prefill from documents; Add field.

children.name: 3 · Interview modality
children.note: Interview date, start and end time, clinic location; the modality text fills in automatically (FR).

children.name: 4 · Identification
children.note: Prefill from case documents; Add field.

children.name: 5 · Medical history and therapeutic events
children.note: Prefill from case documents; Add field.

children.name: 6 · Current medication and ongoing therapeutic measures
children.note: Prefill from case documents; Add field.

children.name: 7 · Factual history and evolution
children.note: Drafted from the documents with the Section 7 prompt (version picker, Apply template, Regenerate), Edit, Copy, Export Word, Export with citations.

children.name: 8 · Subjective questionnaire and current state
children.note: Appréciation subjective, plaintes et problèmes, impact sur AVQ / AVD; dictation tools with input and output language, Start dictation, Upload transcript.

children.name: 9 · Physical examination
children.note: Guided or manual; body regions Rachis (lumbar, cervical, thoracic), membre supérieur, membre inférieur, contrôle; palpation, inspection, articular amplitude table, specific maneuvers (Lasègue, Schober, Gaenslen…) with + ± − NT; Auto-complete with ALIE; Dictate.

children.name: 10 · Paraclinical examinations
children.note: Static text referring to section 7.

children.name: 11 · Conclusion
children.note: Generate conclusion; summary, subjective and objective findings, diagnosis, date of consolidation, existence of impairment (permanent / temporary / no / undetermined), functional limitations; Suggest from documents per field; physician confirmation.

children.name: 12 · APIPP / DC400 impairment percentage
children.note: Permanent physical or psychological impairment percentage section (seen in the section list).

children.name: Signature block
children.note: Signature section fed by the physician profile with a profile-incomplete warning.

features.name: Section 7 factual history generator
features.note: Writes Section 7 from a dated fact ledger with citation markers, density budget, batch continuation and canonical versions per workspace. Many prompt versions (v0.1 to v0.5.5, FR and EN).

features.name: Report-Unit Lab segmentation engine
features.note: Masked one-call report segmentation with regime vocabularies for CNESST, SAAQ, IVAC and CIVIL. Drives the report units in Health and Run segmentation in Legal.

features.name: Context panel
features.note: Right panel on every case step: document and page counts, review items waiting, consent status, missing information (injury description, diagnosis, injury date), quick actions Review, Report, Consent. Collapsible.

features.name: Consent management
features.note: Consent recorded per case (Active consent on file) with a Consent action in both workspaces; consent revoked is a critical notification.

features.name: Portal
features.note: Client-facing secure exchange that consolidates Share and the Collaboration panel: a portal inbox in the main navigation, a portal panel on each case, and an external page (exchange.alie.app) where third parties verify a code, upload requested files or download the documents sent to them. Prototype by David (ALIE Portal Flow).

children.name: Portal inbox and sent
children.note: Portal entry in the main navigation with an unread badge. Inbox and Sent tabs, filter by owner (All, A. Auger, Me Mercure), search across recipients, cases and files. Each row shows the sender, subject, files received, who it is for, its status (received, no case, internal, downloaded) and time; rows can be selected.

children.name: New request: request files or send securely
children.note: New opens two flows: Request files (ask a third party for documents through a secure link) or Send securely (share documents with an external recipient).

children.name: Case portal panel
children.note: Portal item in the case left rail with a badge. Inbox, Sent and Archive for that case; Add to sources moves received files into the case; Reply answers in the thread; Back to case.

children.name: Secure link management
children.note: Each exchange carries an expiry date and a view limit (for example 2 of 5 views used). Resend, Extend, Revoke, and View activity show every access, download and code attempt.

children.name: External exchange: verify access
children.note: exchange.alie.app page for the outside party: the request is described, a six-digit code given separately unlocks it, no account needed, French available, expiry shown. Every access recorded.

children.name: External exchange: upload and receipt
children.note: After verification the recipient reviews what is requested, uploads the files (Send N files) and gets a receipt (Files transmitted).

children.name: External exchange: download page
children.note: Documents for your expertise mandate listed with type and size; Download, Again, Download all as one PDF; expiry and views left; every download visible to the sender.

children.name: Link states: expired, revoked, locked
children.note: Link expired (410, recorded), Access revoked (410, recorded), Locked after 3 wrong codes (423, sender alerted and can issue a replacement).
